items.text: Although amino acids are usually referred toby their common names,such asglycine,HNCHCOOH, and alanine,HNCH(CH)COOH,they also have systematic names using the rules defined byIUPAC They are named as amine derivatives of carboxylic acids, using the prefix amino to indicate the presence of the amine group,NH2. A locant is used to indicate the position of the amine group in the carbonchain ofthe carboxylic acid.
